verdict.rationale: Poke documents event-driven triggering: external services such as GitHub, CI/CD or monitoring tools can call its API to trigger Poke when something happens. Recipes are described as a way to set up automations. There is no documented rule builder for defining conditions and the actions that follow automatically. missing for 10: explicit user-defined trigger/condition/action rule configuration, documentation of native event sources beyond inbound API calls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Services like GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, or monitoring tools can trigger Poke when something happens.
